senses.gloss: attendance, repair. ב׳ הבית (II Kings XII, 8) keeping the Temple in repair.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 8:3:4">Y. Pes. VIII, 36ᵃ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Mishnah Temurah 1:6">Tem. I, 6</cite> <he>קדשי ב׳ הב׳</he> (Mish. <he>קרבנות</he>) offerings for the Temple repair, opp. to <he>קדשי מזבח</he> objects dedicated for sacrifices.
<cite ref="Mishnah Temurah 7:1">Ibid. VII, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>בְּדָקִים</he>, constr. <he>בִּדְקֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 32a:7">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ מיתה</he> breaches through which death enters, i.e. sins for which one is visited with death; v. <cite ref="D00074"><he>דֶּבֶק</he></cite>.
